id: title:jonmcwest:fit the logs viewer in narrow panes

review.posthog_relevance: Frontend UI layout and accessibility for date range selection controls.
review.reason: The change is a localized, bounded UI improvement. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F3.H1 demonstrate a CSS and JSX change to prevent date range buttons from wrapping and allow truncation, while P1.F5.H2 replaces a scene-specific component with a shared one. This supports the tier 1 classification: a narrow, localised maintenance or small behaviour correction. No systemic risk reduction or broader,
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to the visual behavior of the date picker; no backend or query changes are observed. The score does not account for unverified user benefit or adoption.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of implementation and checks.

observations.behavior: Adds CSS property min-width: 0 to the DateRangePickerButtonGroup flex container, and adds the truncate prop to the button. P1.F1.H1: .DateRangePickerButtonGroup { display: flex; min-width: 0; } P1.F2.H1: onClick={() => setPopoverOpen(!popoverOpen)} +                truncate
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the button label to truncate rather than expanding and breaking the flex layout, supporting the CSS min-width: 0 change.

observations.behavior: Replaces className flex shrink-0 with flex gap-1.5 min-w-0. P1.F3.H1: <div className="flex gap-1.5 min-w-0"> P1.F4.H1: <div className="flex gap-1.5 min-w-0">
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the container's behavior from shrinking to allowing overflow, while the min-w-0 and flex properties allow child elements to truncate, supporting the date range selection and query controls layout.

observations.behavior: Replaces SceneDivider with LemonDivider. P1.F5.H2: <LemonDivider className="my-0" />
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces a scene-specific divider with a shared UI component, potentially unifying styling and removing dependency on scene-specific layout.
